cands.name: Jeana Ross

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 27 (Marshall County area) since May 2024. Former secretary of the Alabama Department of Early Childhood Education (2012–2020), policy director at the Alabama Extended Learning Alliance, and education consultant.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Jeana Ross was born or raised, or when she moved to Alabama. The pages we had did not show the bills she has sponsored, so we cannot say what she has done on any platform issue. We found no campaign statements, questionnaire answers or interviews on her positions. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026. We found no documented positions on data centers or development, no controversies and no endorsements.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2024; led the Alabama Department of Early Childhood Education as secretary from 2012 to 2020 under Gov. Kay Ivey; Director of Policy and Children's Affairs at the Alabama Extended Learning Alliance; education consultant.
qual.why: She has held a legislative seat since 2024 and has a long state policy and agency-leadership career, which fits the lawmaking and budget job. Her prior legislative tenure is short, so the score sits in the upper-middle of the high range.
